documents.text: 第八章跟完了一次扫描。现在离开那份案例。说明任意允许输入为什么都成立。从空状态起步。连接每次处理、下一处必达和结束时的完整结果。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">第<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 1 zhang 1">八章</phoneme>跟<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2 le 5 yi 2 ci 4 sao 3 miao 2">完了一次扫描</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>现在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 2">离</phoneme>开<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="na 4 fen 4">那份</phoneme>案<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 4">例</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shuo 1 ming 2 ren 4 yi 4 yun 2 xu 3">说明任意允许</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4 shen 2 me 5 dou 1">为什么都</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 4">立</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2 kong 1">从空</phoneme>状态起步。<break time="200ms"/>连<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 1">接</phoneme>每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ci 4 chu 2">次处</phoneme>理、下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 chu 4">一处</phoneme>必<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 2 he 2 jie 2">达和结</phoneme>束时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 wan 2">的完</phoneme>整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 guo 3">结果</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 输入是有限份闭线段。坐标是精确有理数。共端点、内部端点、多线共点、同列、重叠、竖直线段和点输入都允许。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 you 3 xian 4 fen 4">是有限份</phoneme>闭线段。<break time="200ms"/>坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jing 1">是精</phoneme>确<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 2">有</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gong 4">共</phoneme>端点、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="nei 4 bu 4">内部</phoneme>端点、多线<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gong 4">共</phoneme>点、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 lie 4">同列</phoneme>、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2">重</phoneme>叠、竖直线段<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1 yun 2 xu 3">都允许</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 每个相交的原始无序输入对。恰好留下一个完整交集。可以是点。也可以是非零长度闭区间。不相交的对没有结果。完全重合和端点反向的输入仍保留各自身份。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 5 xiang 1">个相</phoneme>交<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>原始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wu 2">无</phoneme>序输入对。<break time="200ms"/>恰<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hao 3 liu 2">好留</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ge 5 wan 2">一个完</phoneme>整交集。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 2 yi 3 shi 4">可以是</phoneme>点。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 3 ke 2 yi 3 shi 4 fei 1 ling 2 chang 2 du 4">也可以是非零长度</phoneme>闭<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 1 jian 1">区间</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 xiang 1">不相</phoneme>交<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3 jie 2 guo 3">没有结果</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2 he 2 he 2">重合和</phoneme>端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fan 3">反</phoneme>向<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>输入仍保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2 ge 4">留各</phoneme>自<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 没有非零竖直输入时。沿用原坐标。否则按第七章选安全系数。统一变换全部输入。包括点。这里使用第七章已证明安全的系数。统一满足保序、非竖直和完整交集保持。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3 fei 1 ling 2">没有非零</phoneme>竖直输入时。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yan 2">沿</phoneme>用原坐标。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fou 3">否</phoneme>则按第<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 1 zhang 1">七章</phoneme>选安全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xi 4 shu 4">系数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>统<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>变换全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">部</phoneme>输入。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bao 1 kuo 4">包括</phoneme>点。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 li 3">这里</phoneme>使用第<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 1 zhang 1 yi 3">七章已</phoneme>证<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ming 2">明</phoneme>安全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 xi 4 shu 4">的系数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>统<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>满<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zu 2">足</phoneme>保序、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1">非</phoneme>竖直<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 wan 2">和完</phoneme>整交集保持。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 以下坐标都指实际扫描坐标。先到 x 坐标较小的位置。同列再从低到高。无须剪切时仍可能同列。不能省掉第二层比较。两个坐标都相等才合并位置。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3">以</phoneme>下坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1 zhi 3">都指</phoneme>实际<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="sao 3 miao 2">扫描</phoneme>坐标。<break time="400ms"/>先到 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标较小<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 wei 4">的位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 lie 4">同列</phoneme>再<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2">从</phoneme>低到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 1">高</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wu 2">无</phoneme>须剪<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qie 1">切</phoneme>时仍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 3 neng 2 tong 2 lie 4">可能同列</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 neng 2 sheng 3 diao 4">不能省掉</phoneme>第二层<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bi 3">比</phoneme>较。<break time="400ms"/>两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 5">个</phoneme>坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1 xiang 1">都相</phoneme>等<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cai 2 he 2 bing 4 wei 4">才合并位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 第三章的精确计算用于求交、同点识别、闭范围和次序比较。剪切负责满足几何条件。精确计算负责忠实判断。两者不能互相替代。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">第三<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhang 1 de 5 jing 1">章的精</phoneme>确计算用<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 2">于</phoneme>求交、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 2 bie 2">识别</phoneme>、闭范围<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 ci 4">和次</phoneme>序<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bi 3">比</phoneme>较。<break time="400ms"/>剪<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qie 1">切</phoneme>负责满<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zu 2 ji 3 he 2">足几何</phoneme>条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jian 4">件</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1">精</phoneme>确计算负责忠实判断。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 2">两</phoneme>者<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 neng 2">不能</phoneme>互<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1">相</phoneme>替代。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 第三节先只回答：此前正确。而且这次确实到达下一处。处理后怎样继续正确。沿用无事件不换序、完整同点收集、分类报告及同列局部更新的结论和条件。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">第三<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">节</phoneme>先<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>回<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 2">答</phoneme>：此<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qian 2 zheng 4">前正</phoneme>确。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="er 2 qie 3 zhe 4 ci 4">而且这次</phoneme>确实到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 2">达</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 chu 4">一处</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理后怎<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yang 4">样</phoneme>继续<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zheng 4">正</phoneme>确。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yan 2">沿</phoneme>用<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wu 2 shi 4 jian 4 bu 2">无事件不</phoneme>换序、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>点收集、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 1">分</phoneme>类报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4">告</phoneme>及<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 lie 4">同列</phoneme>局<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 geng 1">部更</phoneme>新<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 jie 2 lun 4 he 2">的结论和</phoneme>条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jian 4">件</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 第四节再用组发现及同列发现结论。补齐确实到达下一处这个前提。所需条件是此前正确处理、新邻接与覆盖延长都检查。以及真实预约保留。没有假定全部未来交点已登记。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">第四<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">节</phoneme>再用组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fa 1">发</phoneme>现及<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 lie 4 fa 1">同列发</phoneme>现<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 lun 4">结论</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>补<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 2">齐</phoneme>确实到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 2">达</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 chu 4 zhe 4 ge 5 qian 2 ti 2">一处这个前提</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>所<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xu 1">需</phoneme>条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jian 4 shi 4">件是</phoneme>此<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qian 2 zheng 4">前正</phoneme>确<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理、新邻<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 1 yu 3">接与</phoneme>覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4">盖</phoneme>延<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chang 2 dou 1">长都</phoneme>检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3">以</phoneme>及真实预<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yue 1">约</phoneme>保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3 jia 3">没有假</phoneme>定全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">部</phoneme>未来交点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3 deng 1">已登</phoneme>记。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 先说明五项记录。当前指刚完成一个精确位置。尚未处理下一个位置的时刻。同列也有进度。不能只给出 x 坐标就认为状态已经确定。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">先<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shuo 1 ming 2">说明</phoneme>五项记录。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2 zhi 3">当前指</phoneme>刚<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ge 5 jing 1">一个精</phoneme>确<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4">尚</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ge 5 wei 4">一个位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 4">刻</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 lie 4 ye 2 you 3">同列也有</phoneme>进<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4">度</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 neng 2 zhi 2 gei 3">不能只给</phoneme>出 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标就认<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2">为</phoneme>状态<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3 jing 1">已经</phoneme>确定。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 活动成员从自己的开始事件加入。在自己的结束事件报告后退出。点输入只参加自己的位置。非空同线组按当前进度从下到上排列。覆盖只由当前成员决定。不由固定同线归属决定。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="huo 2">活</phoneme>动成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2 cong 2">员从</phoneme>自<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 3 de 5">己的</phoneme>开始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4">事件</phoneme>加入。<break time="200ms"/>在自<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 3 de 5 jie 2">己的结</phoneme>束<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4">事件</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4">告</phoneme>后退出。<break time="400ms"/>点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3 can 1">只参</phoneme>加自<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 3 de 5 wei 4">己的位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1 kong 1 tong 2">非空同</phoneme>线组按<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2">当前</phoneme>进<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4 cong 2">度从</phoneme>下到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4 pai 2 lie 4">上排列</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4 zhi 3 you 2 dang 1 qian 2">盖只由当前</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>决定。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 you 2">不由</phoneme>固定<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>线归<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 3">属</phoneme>决定。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 清单保存尚未取出的端点和已确认的真实未来交点。同位置一份。输入身份全部保留。结果按已经发生的报告时机累计完整交集。每对一次。不是扫描位置左侧所有几何部分的合集。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qing 1 dan 1">清单</phoneme>保存<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4">尚</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 3">取</phoneme>出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 yi 3">和已</phoneme>确认<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>真实未来交点。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 wei 4">同位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 fen 4">一份</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">部</phoneme>保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 guo 3">结果</phoneme>按<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3 jing 1 fa 1">已经发</phoneme>生<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4">告</phoneme>时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 1 lei 3">机累</phoneme>计<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>整交集。<break time="200ms"/>每对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ci 4">一次</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 shi 4 sao 3 miao 2 wei 4">不是扫描位</phoneme>置左<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4 suo 2 you 3 ji 3 he 2 bu 4 fen 4 de 5 he 2">侧所有几何部分的合</phoneme>集。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 左图是一般状态示意。不是某份输入的执行轨迹。虚线表示当前列。低处的相遇块已经处理。保留右侧顺序。高处还没处理。仍保留左侧顺序。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">左图<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 yi 4 ban 1">是一般</phoneme>状态<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 yi 4">示意</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 shi 4 mou 3 fen 4">不是某份</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>执<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xing 2">行</phoneme>轨<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 4">迹</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>虚线表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 dang 1 qian 2 lie 4">示当前列</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>低<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 4 de 5 xiang 1 yu 4 kuai 4 yi 3 jing 1 chu 2">处的相遇块已经处</phoneme>理。<break time="200ms"/>保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>右<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme>顺序。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 1 chu 4 hai 2 mei 2 chu 2">高处还没处</phoneme>理。<break time="200ms"/>仍保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>左<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme>顺序。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 高处尚未处理的结束者仍包含闭端点。不能在低处处理后提前删掉。只有整列处理完。留下的成员才都继续到该列右侧。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 1 chu 4 shang 4">高处尚</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 jie 2">的结</phoneme>束者仍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bao 1 han 2">包含</phoneme>闭端点。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 neng 2">不能</phoneme>在低<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 4 chu 2">处处</phoneme>理后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ti 2 qian 2">提前</phoneme>删<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="diao 4">掉</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3">只有</phoneme>整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lie 4 chu 2">列处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2 cai 2 dou 1">员才都</phoneme>继续到该<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lie 4">列</phoneme>右<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 用 t 表示当前列的 x 坐标。输入身份用 i 表示。开始 x 坐标用 l i 表示。结束 x 坐标用 r i 表示。图中按身份分行展示范围。不表示不同几何高度。

documents.text: 每份当前成员都覆盖这一列。所以左右都允许等号。紫色行是另一份高处未处理的结束者。它的编号用 j 表示。结束 x 坐标用 r j 表示。这个坐标与当前列坐标 t 相等。若改成严格小于。就会把这类成员提前排除。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 dang 1 qian 2">份当前</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2 dou 1">员都</phoneme>覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4 zhe 4 yi 2 lie 4">盖这一列</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3 zuo 3 you 4 dou 1 yun 2 xu 3">所以左右都允许</phoneme>等<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hao 4">号</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>紫<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="se 4 hang 2 shi 4">色行是</phoneme>另<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 fen 4 gao 1 chu 4">一份高处</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 jie 2">的结</phoneme>束者。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ta 1 de 5">它的</phoneme>编<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hao 4">号</phoneme>用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">J</say-as></lang> 表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">示</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>束 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">R</say-as></lang> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">J</say-as></lang> 表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">示</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5">这个</phoneme>坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3 dang 1 qian 2 lie 4">与当前列</phoneme>坐标 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">T</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1">相</phoneme>等。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme>改成严<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 2">格</phoneme>小<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 2">于</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hui 4 ba 3 zhe 4">会把这</phoneme>类成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2 ti 2 qian 2 pai 2 chu 2">员提前排除</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 非空组的当前最远右端。是这些当前成员右端的最大值。未来才开始的成员不在集合中。不能提前把空隙填满。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1 kong 1">非空</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 dang 1 qian 2 zui 4">的当前最</phoneme>远右端。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 zhe 4 xie 1 dang 1 qian 2">是这些当前</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>右端<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 zui 4 da 4">的最大</phoneme>值。<break time="400ms"/>未来<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cai 2">才</phoneme>开始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2 bu 2">员不</phoneme>在集<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 zhong 1">合中</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 neng 2 ti 2 qian 2 ba 3 kong 4">不能提前把空</phoneme>隙<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tian 2">填</phoneme>满。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 初始化时尚未处理任何位置。活动成员为空。没有非空组、组顺序和覆盖。没有到达任何报告时机。结果也为空。这些空记录符合刚才的含义。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">初始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hua 4">化</phoneme>时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4">尚</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ren 4 he 2 wei 4">任何位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="huo 2">活</phoneme>动成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2 wei 2 kong 1">员为空</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3 fei 1 kong 1">没有非空</phoneme>组、组顺序<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4">盖</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3">没有</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 2 ren 4 he 2">达任何</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4">告</phoneme>时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 1">机</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 guo 3 ye 3 wei 2 kong 1">结果也为空</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 xie 1 kong 1">这些空</phoneme>记录符<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme>刚<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cai 2 de 5 han 2">才的含</phoneme>义。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 端点由输入直接给出。非零输入登记两端。点输入登记自己的位置。同位置合并记录。保留全部身份。再按精确次序排列。图中只画已知位置。不预先加入交点。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 2">由</phoneme>输入直<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 1 gei 3">接给</phoneme>出。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1 ling 2">非零</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="deng 1">登</phoneme>记两端。<break time="200ms"/>点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="deng 1">登</phoneme>记自<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 3 de 5 wei 4">己的位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 wei 4">同位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 bing 4">合并</phoneme>记录。<break time="200ms"/>保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 shen 1 fen 4">部身份</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>再按<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1">精</phoneme>确<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ci 4">次</phoneme>序<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="pai 2 lie 4">排列</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>图<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1 zhi 3">中只</phoneme>画<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3 zhi 1 wei 4">已知位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>预先加入交点。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 任何交集位置都不早于参与输入的开始位置。非零输入不竖直。内部严格在开始端点右边。所以非空输入的最早真实事件必是已登记端点。它之前没有活动成员或应报告的对。空输入直接得到完整空结果。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ren 4 he 2">任何</phoneme>交集<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1 bu 4">都不</phoneme>早<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 2 can 1 yu 4">于参与</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>开始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1 ling 2">非零</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>竖直。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="nei 4 bu 4">内部</phoneme>严<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 2">格</phoneme>在开始端点右<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bian 1">边</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3 fei 1 kong 1">所以非空</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 zui 4">的最</phoneme>早真实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4">事件</phoneme>必<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 yi 3 deng 1">是已登</phoneme>记端点。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ta 1 zhi 1 qian 2 mei 2 you 3 huo 2">它之前没有活</phoneme>动成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2 huo 4 ying 1">员或应</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4 de 5">告的</phoneme>对。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1">空</phoneme>输入直<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 1 de 2">接得</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1 jie 2 guo 3">空结果</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 本次位置用 P 表示。严格更早的真实事件已依次正确处理。而且 P 确实是下一处。这里只证明满足这两个前提以后怎样保持正确。不假定更晚的交点都已登记。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ben 3 ci 4 wei 4">本次位</phoneme>置用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">示</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>严<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 2 geng 4">格更</phoneme>早<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>真实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4 yi 3 yi 1 ci 4 zheng 4">事件已依次正</phoneme>确<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="er 2 qie 3">而且</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 确实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">是</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 chu 4">一处</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 li 3 zhi 3">这里只</phoneme>证<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ming 2">明</phoneme>满<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zu 2 zhe 4">足这</phoneme>两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 5 qian 2 ti 2 yi 3">个前提以</phoneme>后怎<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yang 4">样</phoneme>保持<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zheng 4">正</phoneme>确。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 jia 3">不假</phoneme>定<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="geng 4">更</phoneme>晚<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>交点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1 yi 3 deng 1">都已登</phoneme>记。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 从上次处理后到 P 之前。没有跳过别的端点或交点。成员和组顺序仍可用。若 P 在同列高处。使用低处已更新、高处未更新的中间状态。第六章保证仍能按高度找齐块。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2 shang 4 ci 4 chu 2">从上次处</phoneme>理后到 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 1 qian 2">之前</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3 tiao 4 guo 4 bie 2 de 5">没有跳过别的</phoneme>端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="huo 4">或</phoneme>交点。<break time="200ms"/>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2 he 2">员和</phoneme>组顺序仍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 3">可</phoneme>用。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 lie 4 gao 1 chu 4">同列高处</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>使用低<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 4 yi 3 geng 1">处已更</phoneme>新、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 1 chu 4">高处</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="geng 1">更</phoneme>新<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 zhong 1 jian 1">的中间</phoneme>状态。<break time="400ms"/>第<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 4 zhang 1">六章</phoneme>保证仍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="neng 2">能</phoneme>按<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 1 du 4 zhao 3 qi 2 kuai 4">高度找齐块</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 图中交汇处用 P 表示。预约对只负责发现这个位置。不限制到站后的参与者数量。从正确旧状态找齐经过 P 的组。再展开这些组在这里的全部当前成员。

documents.text: 把在 P 开始的非零输入。以及位于 P 的点输入合进来。点输入只参加这个位置。不进入持续活动顺序。它的身份来自预先登记的端点记录。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme>在 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 开始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 fei 1 ling 2">的非零</phoneme>输入。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3">以</phoneme>及<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4 yu 2">位于</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme>进<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lai 5">来</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3 can 1">只参</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5 wei 4">这个位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>进入持续<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="huo 2">活</phoneme>动顺序。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ta 1 de 5 shen 1 fen 4">它的身份</phoneme>来自预先<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="deng 1">登</phoneme>记<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>端点记录。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 在 P 结束的成员还没退出。所以共端点接触不会丢。端点落在内部时。穿过者来自旧块。多线共点时。整块都收齐。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">在 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>束<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2 hai 2 mei 2">员还没</phoneme>退出。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3 gong 4">所以共</phoneme>端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 1">接</phoneme>触<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 hui 4">不会</phoneme>丢。<break time="400ms"/>端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="luo 4">落</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="nei 4 bu 4">内部</phoneme>时。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chuan 1 guo 4">穿过</phoneme>者来自旧<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kuai 4">块</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>多线<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gong 4">共</phoneme>点时。<break time="200ms"/>整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kuai 4 dou 1">块都</phoneme>收<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 2">齐</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 两份非零输入同线时。后开始者加入。与仍包含此处的成员配对。留下完整闭交集。同点开始者按固定身份顺序逐一加入。每对只有一个较晚的加入时机。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 fei 1 ling 2">份非零</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>线时。<break time="200ms"/>后开始者加入。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme>仍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bao 1 han 2">包含</phoneme>此<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 4 de 5">处的</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>配对。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>整闭交集。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>点开始者按固定<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>顺序<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhu 2 yi 1">逐一</phoneme>加入。<break time="400ms"/>每对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3 yi 2 ge 5">只有一个</phoneme>较晚<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>加入时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 1">机</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 不同组的非零输入在共同位置展开全部跨组成员对。不在这里重报组内对。不同直线至多有一个交点。这个点就是完整交集。也是唯一报告位置。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 tong 2">不同</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 fei 1 ling 2">的非零</phoneme>输入在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gong 4 tong 2 wei 4">共同位</phoneme>置展开全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 kua 4">部跨</phoneme>组成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>对。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 li 3 chong 2">这里重</phoneme>报组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="nei 4">内</phoneme>对。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 tong 2">不同</phoneme>直线<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 4">至</phoneme>多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3 yi 2 ge 5">有一个</phoneme>交点。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5">这个</phoneme>点就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 wan 2">是完</phoneme>整交集。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 3 shi 4 wei 2 yi 1">也是唯一</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4 wei 4">告位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 至少一份是点输入时。在这个点与其他参与者配对。点与点也按无序对各取一次。交集只能是这个点。报告时机只有这一个位置。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 4 shao 3 yi 2 fen 4 shi 4">至少一份是</phoneme>点输入时。<break time="200ms"/>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5">这个</phoneme>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3 qi 2 ta 1 can 1 yu 4">与其他参与</phoneme>者配对。<break time="400ms"/>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 2">与</phoneme>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 3">也</phoneme>按<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wu 2">无</phoneme>序对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 4 qu 3 yi 2 ci 4">各取一次</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>交集<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3 neng 2 shi 4 zhe 4 ge 5">只能是这个</phoneme>点。<break time="200ms"/>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4">告</phoneme>时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 1 zhi 2 you 3 zhe 4 yi 2 ge 5 wei 4">机只有这一个位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 每对要么含点。要么两份都非零。两份都非零时。所在直线要么相同。要么不同。所以三类穷尽且互斥。跨类不会重复。类内唯一性由刚才的规则保证。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">每对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4 me 5 han 2">要么含</phoneme>点。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4 me 5">要么</phoneme>两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 dou 1 fei 1 ling 2">份都非零</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 dou 1 fei 1 ling 2">份都非零</phoneme>时。<break time="200ms"/>所在直线<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4 me 5 xiang 1 tong 2">要么相同</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4 me 5 bu 4 tong 2">要么不同</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3">所以</phoneme>三类穷<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jin 4 qie 3">尽且</phoneme>互<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chi 4">斥</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kua 4">跨</phoneme>类<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 hui 4 chong 2">不会重</phoneme>复。<break time="200ms"/>类<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="nei 4 wei 2 yi 1">内唯一</phoneme>性<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 2">由</phoneme>刚<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cai 2 de 5">才的</phoneme>规则保证。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 收集既完整。又没有混入不经过 P 的成员。因此不漏本次该报的对。也不增加空交集。此前已报告的对不会重报。重复或反向输入仍保留不同身份。交换同一对的次序才不产生新对。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">收集<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 4 wan 2">既完</phoneme>整。<break time="200ms"/>又<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3 hun 4">没有混</phoneme>入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 jing 1 guo 4">不经过</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>因此<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 lou 4 ben 3 ci 4">不漏本次</phoneme>该报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>对。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 3 bu 4 zeng 1">也不增</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1">空</phoneme>交集。<break time="400ms"/>此<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qian 2 yi 3">前已</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4 de 5">告的</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 hui 4 chong 2">不会重</phoneme>报。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2">重</phoneme>复<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="huo 4 fan 3">或反</phoneme>向输入仍保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2 bu 4 tong 2 shen 1 fen 4">留不同身份</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>交换<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 yi 2">同一</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 ci 4">的次</phoneme>序<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cai 2 bu 4">才不</phoneme>产生新对。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 图中是同线的一对非零输入。为区分身份。把各自的范围分行展示。位置 P 是较晚的开始位置。两份输入的原始端点已经全部给定。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">图<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1 shi 4 tong 2">中是同</phoneme>线<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 yi 2">的一</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1 ling 2">非零</phoneme>输入。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4 qu 1 fen 1 shen 1 fen 4">为区分身份</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3 ge 4">把各</phoneme>自<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>范围<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 1 hang 2">分行</phoneme>展<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">示</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">是</phoneme>较晚<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>开始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/>两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>原始端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3 jing 1">已经</phoneme>全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 gei 3">部给</phoneme>定。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 现在就能确定并报告整段闭交集。右端可以在 P 的右边。不必等扫描走到那里。累计结果按报告时机成立。不能把它改写成当前位置左边所有几何部分的合集。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">现在就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="neng 2">能</phoneme>确定<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bing 4">并</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4">告</phoneme>整段闭交集。<break time="200ms"/>右端<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 2 yi 3">可以</phoneme>在 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>右<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bian 1">边</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>必等<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="sao 3 miao 2">扫描</phoneme>走到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="na 4 li 3">那里</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lei 3">累</phoneme>计<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 guo 3">结果</phoneme>按报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4">告</phoneme>时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 1">机</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 4">立</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 neng 2 ba 3 ta 1 gai 2 xie 3">不能把它改写</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2 wei 4">当前位</phoneme>置左<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bian 1 suo 2 you 3 ji 3 he 2 bu 4 fen 4 de 5 he 2">边所有几何部分的合</phoneme>集。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 图中当前位置 P 在低处。高处是同列尚未处理的位置。先报告所有本次该报的对。在 P 结束的成员和点输入。都参加这次报告。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">图<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1 dang 1 qian 2 wei 4">中当前位</phoneme>置 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 在低<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 4">处</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 1 chu 4 shi 4 tong 2 lie 4 shang 4">高处是同列尚</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 wei 4">的位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/>先报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4 suo 2 you 3 ben 3 ci 4">告所有本次</phoneme>该报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>对。<break time="400ms"/>在 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>束<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2 he 2">员和</phoneme>点输入。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1 can 1">都参</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ci 4">这次</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4">告</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 报告完成后。在 P 结束的成员退出。点输入也不留到后面。留下穿过者和非零开始者。只把当前块改成右侧顺序。块外保留原状态。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4 wan 2">告完</phoneme>成后。<break time="200ms"/>在 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>束<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>退出。<break time="200ms"/>点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 3 bu 4 liu 2">也不留</phoneme>到后面。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chuan 1 guo 4">穿过</phoneme>者<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 fei 1 ling 2">和非零</phoneme>开始者。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 ba 3 dang 1 qian 2 kuai 4">只把当前块</phoneme>改成右<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme>顺序。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kuai 4">块</phoneme>外保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>原状态。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 同列高处尚未处理的结束者仍保留。不能随着低处一起删除或换序。低处已处理、高处未处理的约定。就这样延续到下一个位置。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 lie 4 gao 1 chu 4 shang 4">同列高处尚</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 jie 2">的结</phoneme>束者仍保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 neng 2">不能</phoneme>随<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 5">着</phoneme>低<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 4 yi 4">处一</phoneme>起删<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2 huo 4">除或</phoneme>换序。<break time="400ms"/>低<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 4 yi 3 chu 2">处已处</phoneme>理、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 1 chu 4">高处</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 yue 1">的约</phoneme>定。<break time="200ms"/>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 yang 4">这样</phoneme>延续到下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ge 5 wei 4">一个位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 成员变化后重算当前覆盖。图中新增成员使最远右端延长。邻居名字虽然没变。也要补检。确认交点时只能用真实闭范围。不能拿整条支撑直线替代。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>变<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hua 4">化</phoneme>后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2">重</phoneme>算<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2">当前</phoneme>覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4">盖</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>图<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1">中</phoneme>新<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zeng 1">增</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>使<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zui 4">最</phoneme>远右端延<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chang 2">长</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>邻<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ju 1 ming 2 zi 5">居名字</phoneme>虽然<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>变。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 3 yao 4 bu 2">也要补</phoneme>检。<break time="400ms"/>确认交点时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3 neng 2">只能</phoneme>用真实闭范围。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 neng 2">不能</phoneme>拿整条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 1">支</phoneme>撑直线替代。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 若组已没有成员。就退出活动顺序。以后同线成员开始时再加入。尚未开始的部分不能倒过来填补眼前的空隙。也不能提前参与未来检查。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3 mei 2 you 3">已没有</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>就退出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="huo 2">活</phoneme>动顺序。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3">以</phoneme>后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>线成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>开始时再加入。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4">尚</phoneme>未开始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 bu 4 fen 4 bu 4 neng 2 dao 4 guo 4 lai 5 tian 2">的部分不能倒过来填</phoneme>补<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yan 3 qian 2 de 5 kong 4">眼前的空</phoneme>隙。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 3 bu 4 neng 2 ti 2 qian 2 can 1 yu 4">也不能提前参与</phoneme>未来检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 更新形成的新邻接都要检查：新块内部、它与外侧的边界。以及块空时新连上的两侧。这些新邻接检查与覆盖延长补检。两者缺一不可。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="geng 1">更</phoneme>新形成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>新邻<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 1 dou 1 yao 4">接都要</phoneme>检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>：新<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kuai 4 nei 4 bu 4">块内部</phoneme>、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ta 1 yu 3">它与</phoneme>外<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4 de 5 bian 1">侧的边</phoneme>界。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3">以</phoneme>及<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kuai 4 kong 1">块空</phoneme>时新连<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4 de 5">上的</phoneme>两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 xie 1">这些</phoneme>新邻<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 1">接</phoneme>检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2 yu 3">查与</phoneme>覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4">盖</phoneme>延<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chang 2 bu 2">长补</phoneme>检。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 2">两</phoneme>者<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="que 1 yi 1 bu 4 ke 3">缺一不可</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 先确认交点落在真实闭范围。再按 x 坐标优先、同列按高度的完整次序判断严格未来。同列高处仍可在未来。当前位置和过去不重新加入。已登记的真实未来位置继续保留。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">先确认交点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="luo 4">落</phoneme>在真实闭范围。<break time="200ms"/>再按 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 1">优</phoneme>先、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 lie 4">同列</phoneme>按<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 1 du 4 de 5 wan 2">高度的完</phoneme>整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ci 4">次</phoneme>序判断严<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 2">格</phoneme>未来。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 lie 4 gao 1 chu 4">同列高处</phoneme>仍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 3">可</phoneme>在未来。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2 wei 4">当前位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 guo 4 qu 4 bu 4 chong 2">和过去不重</phoneme>新加入。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3 deng 1">已登</phoneme>记<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>真实未来<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置继续保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 重复发现只合并位置。不合并原始输入身份。成员、顺序、覆盖和累计结果的保证继续成立。这次还执行了两类检查。接下来单独说明：为什么所假设的下一处不会被清单跳过。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2">重</phoneme>复<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fa 1">发</phoneme>现<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3 he 2 bing 4 wei 4">只合并位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 he 2 bing 4">不合并</phoneme>原始输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>、顺序、覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4 he 2 lei 3">盖和累</phoneme>计<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 guo 3 de 5">结果的</phoneme>保证继续成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 4">立</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ci 4 hai 2">这次还</phoneme>执<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xing 2 le 5">行了</phoneme>两类检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 1">接</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lai 5 dan 1">来单</phoneme>独<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shuo 1 ming 2">说明</phoneme>：<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4 shen 2 me 5">为什么</phoneme>所<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jia 3">假</phoneme>设<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 chu 4 bu 2 hui 4 bei 4 qing 1 dan 1 tiao 4 guo 4">一处不会被清单跳过</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 现在从已正确处理的边界向后看。若还有真实事件。就取按完整次序最早的一个。并用 Q 表示这个位置。这是证明里选择实际几何位置。不是要求算法先枚举全部交点。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">现在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2 yi 3 zheng 4">从已正</phoneme>确<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 bian 1">的边</phoneme>界向后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kan 4">看</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4 hai 2 you 3">若还有</phoneme>真实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4">事件</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 3">取</phoneme>按<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ci 4">次</phoneme>序<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zui 4">最</phoneme>早<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 yi 2 ge 5">的一个</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bing 4">并</phoneme>用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Q</say-as></lang> 表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 zhe 4 ge 5 wei 4">示这个位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 shi 4">这是</phoneme>证<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ming 2 li 3">明里</phoneme>选<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ze 2">择</phoneme>实际<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 3 he 2 wei 4">几何位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 shi 4 yao 1">不是要</phoneme>求算法先枚举全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">部</phoneme>交点。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 若 Q 带端点或点输入。它在初始化时就已登记。这个位置尚未处理。记录仍在清单里。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Q</say-as></lang> 带端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="huo 4">或</phoneme>点输入。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ta 1">它</phoneme>在初始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hua 4">化</phoneme>时就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3 deng 1">已登</phoneme>记。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5 wei 4">这个位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4">尚</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理。<break time="200ms"/>记录仍在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qing 1 dan 1 li 3">清单里</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 否则。位置 Q 只能是不同组非零输入的真实交点。此前事件已正确处理。两类检查也都执行。当前成员真实覆盖交点。真实预约保留。已有组发现及同列结论于是保证 Q 及时登记。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fou 3">否</phoneme>则。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Q</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3 neng 2 shi 4 bu 4 tong 2">只能是不同</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1 ling 2">非零</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>真实交点。<break time="400ms"/>此<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qian 2 shi 4 jian 4 yi 3 zheng 4">前事件已正</phoneme>确<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理。<break time="200ms"/>两类检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2 ye 3 dou 1">查也都</phoneme>执<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xing 2">行</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2">当前</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>真实覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4">盖</phoneme>交点。<break time="200ms"/>真实预<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yue 1">约</phoneme>保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 you 3">已有</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fa 1">发</phoneme>现及<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 lie 4 jie 2 lun 4 yu 2 shi 4">同列结论于是</phoneme>保证 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Q</say-as></lang> 及时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="deng 1">登</phoneme>记。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 有些交点还要等新邻接或覆盖延长才被发现。邻居不变而覆盖后来才够到。也已被补检覆盖。图中的顺序是完整位置次序。不只是 x 坐标。同列高处也可能是下一处。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3 xie 1">有些</phoneme>交点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hai 2 yao 4">还要</phoneme>等新邻<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 1 huo 4">接或</phoneme>覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4">盖</phoneme>延<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chang 2 cai 2 bei 4 fa 1">长才被发</phoneme>现。<break time="400ms"/>邻<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ju 1 bu 2">居不</phoneme>变<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="er 2">而</phoneme>覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4">盖</phoneme>后来<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cai 2">才</phoneme>够到。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 2 yi 3 bei 4 bu 2">也已被补</phoneme>检覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4">盖</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>图<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1 de 5">中的</phoneme>顺序<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 wan 2">是完</phoneme>整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ci 4">次</phoneme>序。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 zhi 3 shi 4">不只是</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 lie 4 gao 1 chu 4 ye 3 ke 3 neng 2 shi 4">同列高处也可能是</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 chu 4">一处</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 清单只含真实未处理位置。而且已经包含 Q 这个位置。若还有比 Q 更早的清单位置。它也是真实未处理事件。就与 Q 的选择矛盾。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qing 1 dan 1 zhi 3 han 2">清单只含</phoneme>真实未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="er 2 qie 3 yi 3 jing 1 bao 1 han 2">而且已经包含</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Q</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5 wei 4">这个位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4 hai 2 you 3 bi 3">若还有比</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Q</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="geng 4">更</phoneme>早<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 qing 1 dan 1 wei 4">的清单位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ta 1 ye 3 shi 4">它也是</phoneme>真实未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4">事件</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Q</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>选<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ze 2">择</phoneme>矛<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dun 4">盾</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 所以取清单最小位置。必然取到 Q 这个位置。这才补上第三节所需的下一处前提。同位置合并保证只到站一次。到站后仍收齐全部参与者。保留不同原始输入对。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3 qu 3 qing 1 dan 1 zui 4">所以取清单最</phoneme>小<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/>必然<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 3">取</phoneme>到 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Q</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5 wei 4">这个位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 cai 2">这才</phoneme>补<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4">上</phoneme>第三<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">节</phoneme>所<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xu 1 de 5">需的</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 chu 4 qian 2 ti 2">一处前提</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 wei 4">同位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 bing 4">合并</phoneme>保证<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhan 4 yi 2 ci 4">站一次</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhan 4">站</phoneme>后仍收<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 2">齐</phoneme>全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 can 1 yu 4">部参与</phoneme>者。<break time="200ms"/>保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2 bu 4 tong 2">留不同</phoneme>原始输入对。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 第二节建立空状态和第一处。第三节在到达那里后保持保证。并执行两类检查。这就得到一个新的已正确处理边界。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">第二<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">节</phoneme>建<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 4 kong 1">立空</phoneme>状态<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>第<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1 chu 4">一处</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>第三<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">节</phoneme>在到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 2 na 4 li 3">达那里</phoneme>后保持保证。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bing 4">并</phoneme>执<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xing 2">行</phoneme>两类检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 2">得</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ge 5">一个</phoneme>新<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 yi 3 zheng 4">的已正</phoneme>确<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bian 1">边</phoneme>界。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 从这个边界。第四节保证下一处及时登记并被取到。第三节再说明处理后继续正确。每一步只用此前已经建立的状态。没有借用后面的处理结果。因而没有循环论证。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2 zhe 4 ge 5 bian 1">从这个边</phoneme>界。<break time="200ms"/>第四<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">节</phoneme>保证下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 chu 4">一处</phoneme>及时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="deng 1">登</phoneme>记<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bing 4 bei 4 qu 3">并被取</phoneme>到。<break time="200ms"/>第三<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">节</phoneme>再<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shuo 1 ming 2 chu 2">说明处</phoneme>理后继续<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zheng 4">正</phoneme>确。<break time="400ms"/>每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>步<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>用此<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qian 2 yi 3 jing 1">前已经</phoneme>建<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 4 de 5">立的</phoneme>状态。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3">没有</phoneme>借用后面<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 chu 2">的处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 guo 3">结果</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>因<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="er 2 mei 2 you 3">而没有</phoneme>循环<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lun 4">论</phoneme>证。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 输入有限。所以端点和点输入位置有限。非零输入的所在直线也有限。每两条不同直线至多相交一次。只有落在实际闭范围内的位置才成为事件。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3 xian 4">有限</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3">所以</phoneme>端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3 xian 4">有限</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1 ling 2">非零</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>所在直线<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 2 you 3 xian 4">也有限</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">每</phoneme>两条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 tong 2">不同</phoneme>直线<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 4">至</phoneme>多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1">相</phoneme>交<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ci 4">一次</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3 luo 4">只有落</phoneme>在实际闭范围<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="nei 4 de 5 wei 4">内的位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cai 2">才</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2 shi 4 jian 4">为事件</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 重叠区间虽然有无穷多个公共点。但在加入时作为完整区间报告。不会把区间里的每个点都列成事件。因此真实事件位置仍然有限。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2">重</phoneme>叠<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 1 jian 1">区间</phoneme>虽然<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3 wu 2">有无</phoneme>穷多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 5">个</phoneme>公<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gong 4">共</phoneme>点。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dan 4">但</phoneme>在加入时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4 wei 2 wan 2">作为完</phoneme>整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 1 jian 1">区间</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4">告</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 hui 4 ba 3 qu 1 jian 1 li 3 de 5">不会把区间里的</phoneme>每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 5">个</phoneme>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1 lie 4">都列</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4">事件</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>因此真实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4 wei 4">事件位</phoneme>置仍然<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3 xian 4">有限</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 每步只处理有限成员、输入对和检查。处理后移去当前位置。严格未来比较禁止它重新加入。同位置合并也禁止存多份。每次完成一个此前未完成的真实位置。所以只能处理有限次。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">每步<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3 chu 2">只处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3 xian 4">有限</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>、输入对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 qu 4 dang 1 qian 2 wei 4">移去当前位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/>严<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 2">格</phoneme>未来<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bi 3">比</phoneme>较<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jin 4">禁</phoneme>止<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ta 1 chong 2">它重</phoneme>新加入。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 wei 4">同位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 bing 4 ye 3 jin 4">合并也禁</phoneme>止存多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ci 4 wan 2">次完</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ge 5">一个</phoneme>此<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qian 2">前</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>真实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3 zhi 3 neng 2 chu 2">所以只能处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3 xian 4 ci 4">有限次</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 有限终止还不等于结果完整。假设结束时仍有真实事件未处理。就能选出最早的 Q 这个位置。这里需要第四节的下一处必达。不能只靠刚才的有限性。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3 xian 4">有限</phoneme>终止<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hai 2 bu 4">还不</phoneme>等<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 2 jie 2 guo 3 wan 2">于结果完</phoneme>整。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jia 3">假</phoneme>设<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>束时仍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3">有</phoneme>真实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4">事件</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理。<break time="200ms"/>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="neng 2">能</phoneme>选出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zui 4">最</phoneme>早<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Q</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5 wei 4">这个位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 li 3 xu 1 yao 4">这里需要</phoneme>第四<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 de 5">节的</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 chu 4">一处</phoneme>必<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 2">达</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 neng 2 zhi 3">不能只</phoneme>靠刚<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cai 2 de 5 you 3 xian 4">才的有限</phoneme>性。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 第四节保证 Q 已经在清单里。这与清单为空矛盾。所以全部真实事件都已到达。第三节也把正确性保持到了最后一个边界。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">第四<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">节</phoneme>保证 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Q</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3 jing 1">已经</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qing 1 dan 1 li 3">清单里</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 yu 3 qing 1 dan 1 wei 2 kong 1">这与清单为空</phoneme>矛<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dun 4">盾</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3">所以</phoneme>全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">部</phoneme>真实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4 dou 1 yi 3">事件都已</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 2">达</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>第三<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 ye 2 ba 3 zheng 4">节也把正</phoneme>确性保持到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="le 5 zui 4">了最</phoneme>后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ge 5 bian 1">一个边</phoneme>界。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 同线非零相交对的后开始者端点已处理。同点开始者也已按固定身份顺序加入。因此唯一报告时机已经发生。留下完整闭交集。可能是一段区间。也可能只有一个点。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>线<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1 ling 2 xiang 1">非零相</phoneme>交对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>后开始者端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3 chu 2">已处</phoneme>理。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>点开始者<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 2 yi 3">也已</phoneme>按固定<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>顺序加入。<break time="400ms"/>因此<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2 yi 1">唯一</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4">告</phoneme>时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 1 yi 3 jing 1 fa 1">机已经发</phoneme>生。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>整闭交集。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 3 neng 2 shi 4 yi 2">可能是一</phoneme>段<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 1 jian 1">区间</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 3 ke 3 neng 2 zhi 2 you 3 yi 2 ge 5">也可能只有一个</phoneme>点。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 不同组非零相交对的唯一交点已处理。完整相遇块展开了这一对。含点的相交对也在点位置配对完成。这两类都得到那个点。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 tong 2">不同</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1 ling 2 xiang 1">非零相</phoneme>交对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 wei 2 yi 1">的唯一</phoneme>交点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3 chu 2">已处</phoneme>理。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1 yu 4 kuai 4">相遇块</phoneme>展开<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="le 5 zhe 4 yi 2">了这一</phoneme>对。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="han 2">含</phoneme>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 xiang 1">的相</phoneme>交对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 3">也</phoneme>在点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置配对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>成。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme>两类<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1 de 2">都得</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="na 4 ge 5">那个</phoneme>点。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 三类互斥穷尽、类内唯一。又不报告空交集。现在所有报告时机都已发生。所以不漏、不多报、不重复。多个输入对可以共享同一结果位置。位置合并不删去不同的对。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">三类互<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chi 4">斥</phoneme>穷<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jin 4">尽</phoneme>、类<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="nei 4 wei 2 yi 1">内唯一</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>又<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4 kong 1">告空</phoneme>交集。<break time="400ms"/>现在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 you 3">所有</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4">告</phoneme>时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 1 dou 1 yi 3 fa 1">机都已发</phoneme>生。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3 bu 2 lou 4">所以不漏</phoneme>、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>多报、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 chong 2">不重</phoneme>复。<break time="400ms"/>多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 5">个</phoneme>输入对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 2 yi 3 gong 4">可以共</phoneme>享<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 yi 4 jie 2 guo 3 wei 4">同一结果位</phoneme>置。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 bing 4 bu 4">合并不</phoneme>删<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 4 bu 4 tong 2 de 5">去不同的</phoneme>对。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 没有输入时。不需要走出第一步。空结果已经完整。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3">没有</phoneme>输入时。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 xu 1 yao 4">不需要</phoneme>走出第<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>步。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1 jie 2 guo 3 yi 3 jing 1 wan 2">空结果已经完</phoneme>整。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 只有一份输入时。可能处理它的端点。但没有两份不同输入可配对。结果仍为空。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3 yi 2 fen 4">只有一份</phoneme>输入时。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 3 neng 2 chu 2">可能处</phoneme>理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ta 1 de 5">它的</phoneme>端点。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dan 4 mei 2 you 3">但没有</phoneme>两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 bu 4 tong 2">份不同</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 3">可</phoneme>配对。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 guo 3">结果</phoneme>仍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2 kong 1">为空</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 全部互不相交时。每次也都找不到非空输入对。得到空结果。前面的推进和结束理由。从未要求至少有一个交点。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">部</phoneme>互<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 xiang 1">不相</phoneme>交时。<break time="200ms"/>每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ci 4 ye 3 dou 1 zhao 3 bu 5">次也都找不</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1 kong 1">非空</phoneme>输入对。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 2">得</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1 jie 2 guo 3">空结果</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qian 2">前</phoneme>面<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>推进<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 jie 2">和结</phoneme>束理<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 2">由</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2">从</phoneme>未<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 1">要</phoneme>求<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 4 shao 3 you 3 yi 2 ge 5">至少有一个</phoneme>交点。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 没有使用剪切时。结果已经是原坐标中的结果。使用剪切时。字母 x 撇和 y 撇表示扫描坐标。字母 x 和 y 表示原坐标。统一系数仍用 s 表示。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3">没有</phoneme>使用剪<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qie 1">切</phoneme>时。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 guo 3 yi 3 jing 1 shi 4">结果已经是</phoneme>原坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1 de 5 jie 2 guo 3">中的结果</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>使用剪<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qie 1">切</phoneme>时。<break time="200ms"/>字<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mu 3">母</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="pie 3 he 2">撇和</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Y</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="pie 3">撇</phoneme>表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 sao 3 miao 2">示扫描</phoneme>坐标。<break time="200ms"/>字<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mu 3">母</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Y</say-as></lang> 表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">示</phoneme>原坐标。<break time="200ms"/>统<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1 xi 4 shu 4">一系数</phoneme>仍用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">S</say-as></lang> 表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">示</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 用第七章的逆变换。原 x 坐标等于扫描 x 坐标减去系数与扫描 y 坐标的乘积。原 y 坐标保持不变。点还原为点。区间两端逆变换以后。结果是两端之间的整段闭交集。不是两个点结果。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">用第<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 1 zhang 1 de 5">七章的</phoneme>逆变换。<break time="200ms"/>原 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标等<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 2 sao 3 miao 2">于扫描</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标减<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 4 xi 4 shu 4 yu 3 sao 3 miao 2">去系数与扫描</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Y</say-as></lang> 坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 cheng 2 ji 1">的乘积</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>原 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Y</say-as></lang> 坐标保持<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>变。<break time="400ms"/>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="huan 2">还</phoneme>原<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2">为</phoneme>点。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 1 jian 1">区间</phoneme>两端逆变换<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3">以</phoneme>后。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 guo 3 shi 4">结果是</phoneme>两端<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 1 jian 1 de 5">之间的</phoneme>整段闭交集。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 shi 4">不是</phoneme>两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 5">个</phoneme>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 guo 3">结果</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 变换一一对应。身份始终保留。所以不会制造相交对。也不合并重复或反向输入。从空状态到每次必达并保持。再到全部报告完成和原坐标还原。整体证明到此闭合。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">变换<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1 yi 1">一一</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ying 4">应</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>始终保<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liu 2">留</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3 bu 2 hui 4">所以不会</phoneme>制<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zao 4 xiang 1">造相</phoneme>交对。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ye 3 bu 4 he 2 bing 4 chong 2">也不合并重</phoneme>复<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="huo 4 fan 3">或反</phoneme>向输入。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2 kong 1">从空</phoneme>状态到每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ci 4">次</phoneme>必<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 2 bing 4">达并</phoneme>保持。<break time="200ms"/>再到全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">部</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4 wan 2">告完</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>原坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="huan 2">还</phoneme>原。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zheng 2 ti 3">整体</phoneme>证<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ming 2">明</phoneme>到此闭<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>
